definitions.tagged: A post the AI tagger has read and filled in the codebook for (it can still turn out not to be about SIPs).
definitions.relevant: A tagged post that the tagger confirmed is about starting, continuing, pausing or stopping a SIP, or first-time mutual fund investing. Every count, chart, quote and answer in the dashboard uses relevant tagged posts only.
definitions.staff: TradingQ&A replies written by the platform's own staff are not investors: they are left out of every count and kept only as context for the thread.
definitions.quick_filter: An earlier, cheaper AI step that screens all cleaned posts. It decides which posts get tagged; it is not the same as 'relevant'.

models.job: Says yes / no / unsure: is this post about SIP or mutual fund investing? Two plain-code safety nets turn risky 'no' answers into 'unsure'.
Fills in the codebook for each post: journey stage, what happened to the SIP, voluntary or involuntary, stated triggers, deeper reason, emotion, severity, an exact quote.
Tags a different random half of the posts in parallel, and the same 30 posts as the first tagger for an agreement check.
Turns each post into numbers so similar posts can be grouped (themes) and found ('Ask the data').
